predictions.coreRecommendation: Back Göztepe to capitalize on their four-match winning surge and defeat an away-impotent Başakşehir side.
possibilityAssessment: Göztepe Home Win via intense high-press transitions (Confidence: Moderate, Value: High)
Over 2.5 Total Match Goals supported by high season goal averages (Confidence: Moderate, Value: Moderate)

bet_recommendations.match_highlight: Göztepe hunting fifth straight win against winless travelers Başakşehir

spf.comment: Göztepe's four-game winning streak and lethal vertical counter-press directly exploit Başakşehir's winless road record.

over_under.comment: Season match goal averages of 3.8 for Göztepe and 3.3 for Başakşehir strongly support exceeding the 2.5 goal line.

score.comment: Göztepe's scoring consistency points to a 2:1 victory, with 2:0 acting as the logical clean-sheet hedge.

goals.comment: The convergence of home attacking momentum and away defensive vulnerability favors 3 or 2 total match goals.

bqc.comment: Başakşehir's 75% away half-time draw rate favors Draw-Win, with Win-Win covering Göztepe's frequent early blitzes.
